title: 14-BCV-013 - Polyethylene film for greenhouse enclosures
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA addresses commercial greenhouse enclosure film that does not meet CAN/ULC-S109 and cites ABC Article 3.1.6.5.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-009 PDF, p.1, PURPOSE and CODE REFERENCES

facts.text: Its permission is limited to plant-growing greenhouses without public access and requires polyethylene film with flame-spread rating no greater than 25; other uses, including customer sales areas, remain within the stated CAN/ULC-S109 requirement.
